example.heic is the upstream libheif example image, used only for local decoder tests.
Source: https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/blob/master/examples/example.heic
The examples directory is distributed under the MIT license; see LICENSE.
It is never uploaded to YouCam.

portrait.jpg is the TensorFlow.js face-detection test image, used only for offline face-framing tests.
Source: https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs-models/blob/master/face-detection/test_data/portrait.jpg
See LICENSE-portrait (Apache 2.0). It is never uploaded to YouCam.
